confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Northeast Brazil pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by beachfront location and season. BRL values were converted at an assumed rate of about 5.5 BRL per USD. The FX observation was taken from search results citing the RBA page, not read directly, and may be provisional for 2026-10-16.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other mid-sized Northeast Brazilian tourist cities such as Salvador and Fortaleza, priced somewhat below Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. No specific comparable venues were checked.
